$description: MetricCard (platform/components/MetricCard): one key figure in a card, with one anatomy for its twelve types (owner, 2026-10-19). The frame matches Panel's values. All tokens are internal values; none is a public hook.

metric-card-divider-color.$description: MetricCard: the lines under the header and over the footer.

metric-card-divider-width.$description: MetricCard: the width of those lines.

metric-card-padding-inline.$description: MetricCard: the inline padding of the header, the body and the footer.

metric-card-header-gap.$description: MetricCard: between the heading and the actions.

metric-card-heading-row-gap.$description: MetricCard: between the title and the context line.

metric-card-title-gap.$description: MetricCard: between the icon and the title.

metric-card-actions-gap.$description: MetricCard: between the info button, the filter and the More menu.

metric-card-body-row-gap.$description: MetricCard: between the figure, the change and the visual.

metric-card-beside-gap.$description: MetricCard, beside layout: between the figure and the visual; person: between the picture and the figure.

metric-card-context-text.$description: MetricCard: the context line (the scope or the period).

metric-card-value-sm-font-size.$description: MetricCard size sm: the value (display size 24).

metric-card-value-md-font-size.$description: MetricCard size md: the value (display size 28).

metric-card-value-lg-font-size.$description: MetricCard size lg: the value (display size 36), for a dashboard's first row.

metric-card-unit-font-size.$description: MetricCard: the unit or the target.

metric-card-figure-gap.$description: MetricCard: between the value, the unit and the target.

metric-card-change-gap.$description: MetricCard: between the arrow, the amount and what it is compared with.

metric-card-delta-font-family.$description: MetricCard: the change's amount, a technical value.

metric-card-delta-good-text.$description: MetricCard: a change that moved the good way.

metric-card-delta-bad-text.$description: MetricCard: a change that moved the bad way.

metric-card-delta-neutral-text.$description: MetricCard: a change with no good or bad direction.

metric-card-label-font-size.$description: MetricCard: the rows and labels inside the visual.

metric-card-small-font-size.$description: MetricCard: the day letters and the calendar's day numbers.

metric-card-subtle-text.$description: MetricCard: ranks, day letters, days still to come.

metric-card-rows-gap.$description: MetricCard: between rows of measures (progress rows, ranges, bars).

metric-card-row-padding-block.$description: MetricCard: the block padding of a list row.

metric-card-cell-gap.$description: MetricCard: between the days of a week or a month.

metric-card-bar-height.$description: MetricCard: the split bar of a breakdown or a comparison.

metric-card-bar-radius.$description: MetricCard: the ends of the split bar (ProgressBar's).

metric-card-track-background.$description: MetricCard: the empty part of a day's bar and a day with no level.

metric-card-week-bar-height.$description: MetricCard week: the full height of a day's bar.

metric-card-week-bar-width.$description: MetricCard week: the width of a day's bar.

metric-card-day-height.$description: MetricCard month: the height of a day.

metric-card-today-outline-width.$description: MetricCard month: the outline around today.

metric-card-today-outline-color.$description: MetricCard month: the outline around today.

metric-card-edge-width.$description: MetricCard edge style: the colored start edge.

metric-card-on-color-text.$description: MetricCard filled and gradient styles: every text on the data color.

metric-card-on-color-divider.$description: MetricCard filled and gradient styles: the header and footer lines.

metric-card-tile-font-size.$description: MetricCard tile layout: the title before the value.

metric-card-link-hover-border-color.$description: MetricCard with a link: the border while the pointer is over it.

metric-card-focus-outline-color.$description: MetricCard with a link: the focus outline.

metric-card-focus-outline-width.$description: MetricCard with a link: the focus outline's width.

metric-card-focus-outline-offset.$description: MetricCard with a link: the focus outline's offset.
